# HAZWOPER Careers

> Get the training employers look for in hazardous waste, remediation and environmental services jobs: 40-hour and 24-hour HAZWOPER, RCRA/DOT, waste technician, refresher and awareness courses.

HAZWOPER Careers (https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, RCRA/DOT Combined, Waste Technician or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The certification most environmental field jobs list first. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). For roles with limited site exposure. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [EPA RCRA/DOT Combined Hazardous Materials Compliance Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, RCRA + 49 CFR 172. Waste and hazmat shipping knowledge that sets applicants apart. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training?buy=403
- [OSHA HAZWOPER and RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Technician Safety Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-hazwoper-and-rcra-hazardous-waste-management-technician-safety-training): $199.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / RCRA. Technician skills for environmental services companies. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-hazwoper-and-rcra-hazardous-waste-management-technician-safety-training?buy=599
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). Keep your certification current between jobs. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). A short, affordable first certificate. Enroll: https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

- [What does a HAZWOPER technician do all day?](https://careers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/what-hazwoper-technicians-do): A realistic look at field work in remediation and waste services.
